item.title: Supercharged ⚡️ SSH
item.description: I have been working with servers for quite a few years now and SSH has become a swiss army knife of functionality for far more than just remote logins. It all started out with storing the credentials in a simple spreadsheet/CSV file and copy-pasting the details in the terminal. Over the years, the servers have grown from a handful to ~50 plus and counting. And this has made the spreadsheet/CSV archaic to work with.
